prompt: In the past, most people spend their entire career working for one company, whereas people nowadays move from one job to another. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each? Which do you think is better?
essay:
Formerly, many individuals spend thier whole career working for one company, while people nowadays tend to change their jobs frequently from one company to another. I think that working in one job is better because workers have enough time to focus on building relationships and gaining experience in the same field.

On the one hand, nowadays, people choose to change their workplaces regularly because they have different options of companies. This leads them to gain experience in different roles and environments. However, they do not have enough time to be dedicated to building relationships and gain one specific work experience due to the limited number of positions they have. For example, when people switch jobs frequently, they can not be specialised in one specific role. Consequently, they cannot solve complex problems and make the right decision in some critical situations.

On the other hand, in the past, it was difficult to find roles because the market lacked companies, and people had to commit to one workplace. However, this helped them  to be more specialised in a particular position, because they used their time and effort to learn what they can do throughout their career. For instance, it is remarkable that the woodworkers and craftsmen have many skills both socially and professionally. This is because they spent their age in a specific role in the same institution. As a result, they became proficient in their work perfectly.

In conclusion, working in one corporation with one specialised skill is much better than changing environments and fields regularly because it has sufficient time to learn, build relationships, and gain experience.
